command.isekai_mahou.enigma.all: All 8 enigmas (tier %s) built side by side in front of you.
command.isekai_mahou.enigma.demo: Enigma %s (tier %s) built in front of you.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.beam.1: Turn the mirrors (right-click) to carry the beam from the lantern to the crystal lamp.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.beam.2: Turn the mirrors to carry the beam to the crystal lamp. Pillars block it; not every mirror is part of the path.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.beam.3: Five turns, false mirrors and pillars. Trace the path backwards, starting from the crystal lamp.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.binary.1: Each raised lever adds the number written behind it. Make the sum match the Seal's number and press the button.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.binary.2: From right to left the levers are worth I, II, IV, VIII… (each double its neighbour). Make the Seal's number and press the button.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.binary.3: The Seal asks for a sum in Roman numerals. Solve it; then, with levers worth I, II, IV… from right to left, form the result.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.cipher.1: Each rune is worth a different number from 1 to 9. Read the tablets, work out the values and touch the runes that spell the lock's number.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.cipher.2: Each rune is worth a different number from 1 to 9; the tablets around the room relate them. Spell the lock's number with the runes.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.cipher.3: Five runes, different values from 1 to 9, and no tablet gives a value outright. There is only one answer: deduce it.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.crates.1: Push the barrels (right-click, standing next to them) onto the plates. They only go forward — you can never pull.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.crates.2: Get every barrel onto a plate. A barrel in a corner never comes out: the button on the Seal restarts.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.crates.3: Three barrels, little room. Plan the order of pushes; one wrong step jams everything. The button on the Seal restarts.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.lights.1: Touching a floor rune flips it and its neighbours (front, back, sides). Light them all.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.lights.2: Touching a rune flips it and its 4 neighbours. Light them all. The order of touches doesn't matter — and touching twice undoes it.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.lights.3: Touching a rune flips it and its 4 neighbours. Light all 25. Master's tip: solve one row at a time, chasing the dark ones to the last row.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.path.1: Cross by stepping on the colours in the order of the side column's blocks (front to back), repeating. One step at a time — forward, back or sideways.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.path.2: Follow the colour order of the side column, repeating, one step at a time. There are dead ends: think before stepping. A misstep sends you back.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.path.3: The colour order isn't written: the candles mark the start of the path. Work out the cycle and cross one step at a time.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.pattern.1: Each rune row (front to back) is born from the previous one by a simple rule. Build the next one on the row of plates and press the button.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.pattern.2: Each row is born from the previous one by a fixed rule — maybe one that changes a little each step. Build the next and press the button. Mistakes cost.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.pattern.3: Four rows, one rule. Careful: the rule may look more than one row back, or at each rune's neighbours. Build the next and press the button.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.statues.1: The Faithful always tell the truth; Traitors always lie. Only one statue guards the Key. Touch them to listen and pull the guardian's lever.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.statues.2: The Faithful always tell the truth; Traitors always lie. Only one guards the Key. No single sentence is enough: cross-check them.
enigma.isekai_mahou.hint.statues.3: Four statues, Faithful and Traitors. Only one guards the Key. Test hypotheses: assume one is Faithful and see whether everything holds.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.diff_me: %s and I are of different kinds.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.key_knave: Whoever guards the Key is a Traitor.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.key_knight: Whoever guards the Key is Faithful.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.knave_or_key: %s is a Traitor, or guards the Key (or both).
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.notkey_me: I do not guard the Key.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.one_knight: Exactly one of us is Faithful.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.same: %s and %s are of the same kind.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.same_me: %s and I are of the same kind.
enigma.isekai_mahou.say.two_knaves: At least two of us are Traitors.
enigma.isekai_mahou.title: %s — %s
hint.isekai_mahou.depths_enigma: Enigma: touch the Seal for the rule; sneak + touch buys a hint; the button on top of the Seal resets it.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.beam.reveal: Hint: a mirror on the path turned to the right position.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.binary.revea: Hint: lever %s (from the left) must be %s.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.cipher.code: The lock asks for the number: %s
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.cipher.table: There are %s tablets around the room with clues.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.clue_gift: The solved enigma whispers a clue for the next one (%s):
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.cooldown: The seal still hums from the mistake… wait a moment.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.crates.block: It won't move: something is in the way.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.crates.how: Stand on the floor right next to the barrel to push it away from you.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.crates.revea: Hint: push the marked barrel towards the green sparkles (%s pushes to go).
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.crates.stuck: Hint: as things stand there is no solution any more. Press the button on top of the Seal to restart.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.hint_none: The Seal has nothing more to reveal.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.hint_offer: Sneak + touch the Seal: buy a hint (%s experience levels). Button on top of the Seal: reset.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.hint_offer_f: Sneak + touch the Seal: a free hint. Button on top of the Seal: reset.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.lights.revea: Hint: the glowing rune is part of a solution — touch it.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.locked: This enigma still sleeps (beat the floor's challenge first).
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.locked_chain: Sealed: solve the other enigma nearby first.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.path.fall: Wrong step! The floor sends you back to the start.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.path.reveal: Hint: more candles lit along the start of the path.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.pattern.fixe: This rune was revealed and can't change.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.pattern.reve: Hint: in the last row, rune %s (from the left) is %s.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.statues.notk: Hint: the Key is NOT with Statue %s.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.tower_floor: Hall of Enigmas: %s enigma(s). Touch each Seal for its rule; the first unlocks the second.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.tower_waves_: The waves are over — now the floor's enigma has awakened. Solve it to open the stairs.
message.isekai_mahou.enigma.wrong: Wrong! The seal punishes your boldness.
message.isekai_mahou.ward.protected: Ancient magic guards this place: nothing breaks and nothing is built here.
